vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit. In-pod this is the port-forward tunnel http://localhost:8095 (see gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md for why the public ingress is unreachable from agent pods). The harness hits {{TARGET_URL}}/feed and /feed?view=lanes, and samples {{TARGET_URL}}/feed/events.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (date stamp or fire-time ISO) used as the output directory name under docs/feed-quality/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding and gives the report step a previous-iteration to diff against.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (ka-0000004907, the activity-feed build/promotion epic). All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here, and the report + promotion-gate roll-up comments land on it.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): warm up {{TARGET_URL}} and confirm /feed + /feed/events are live
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Confirm /feed is reachable

Confirm the activity-feed surfaces are reachable before we burn cycles. The two
captured surfaces are the **chronological feed** (`GET /feed`, handler
`handleFeed` in `feed.go`) and its **lane-grouped variant** (`GET
/feed?view=lanes`). Both render the SAME `beads.bead.>` lifecycle stream
(seed via `GET /v1/events` REST backfill, then live over SSE on `/feed/events`,
fanned out by `bead_feed_hub.go`). This is the page slated for promotion to
`/` (epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}, decision ka-0000001808 chose clean-first), so the
whole point is to score whether it "tells the story of the workflow without
waste or nonsense" (Matt) BEFORE the irreversible swap.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

Follow `gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md` verbatim. `{{TARGET_URL}}`
is expected to be `http://localhost:8095`. Agent pods have no public route to
the viewer; port-forward to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` and authenticate
with a Keycloak `client_credentials` bearer (advice `ka-0000006483`, helper
`gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh`). Also port-forward
`svc/gardenio-beads:8080` and bootstrap the operator row via
`POST /v1/operators/me/aliases` so authenticated pages render real content.

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 > /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
BEADS_PF_PID=$!
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "http://localhost:8095/health" && break; sleep 1; done
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-feed-signal-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases | jq .
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware). With
it, the viewer's `extractToken()` accepts the `Authorization` header directly.


### Verify the surfaces

With `VIEWER_BEARER` set, all of these must be < 400:

```bash
for path in "/feed" "/feed?view=lanes" "/feed/events?probe=1"; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 8 \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}")
  printf '%-28s -> %s\n' "$path" "$code"
done
```

`/feed/events` is an SSE stream (it will hold the connection open); `--max-time
8` returns 28 (operation timeout) once bytes flow, which is FINE — what matters
is the initial HTTP status was < 400 and the `: connected` comment + at least
one `event:` line arrived. Capture a short sample to confirm the stream is live:

```bash
timeout 8 curl -sN -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
  "{{TARGET_URL}}/feed/events" | head -40 || true
```

### Deliverables (post as comments, then close)
- Comment: per-path HTTP status table for `/feed` + `/feed?view=lanes`.
- Comment: first ~10 lines of the `/feed/events` SSE sample (proves the live
  stream is wired, not just the seed).
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-path failure detail.

If `/feed` or `/feed?view=lanes` returns >= 400, or the SSE stream never emits
`: connected`, do NOT close — file a bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK
(comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). A broken feed surface is itself the
highest-severity Correctness finding and blocks the promotion gate outright.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM for /feed + /feed?view=lanes + a /feed/events sample
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture — screenshots + DOM + a live /feed/events sample

Run the Playwright harness against `{{TARGET_URL}}` for both feed surfaces and
store output under `docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`. The harness
injects `Authorization: Bearer $BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER` as an extraHTTPHeader, and
the spec captures `/feed` as page `feed` and `/feed?view=lanes` as `feed-lanes`
when `SCREENSHOT_FEED` is set (ka-0000004907). The feed mounts a long-lived SSE
channel, so the spec captures it in SSE mode with a 6s settle so the first-paint
seed plus a few live cards land in the DOM.

In ADDITION to the rendered DOM, capture a raw `/feed/events` SSE sample. The
seed (first paint) and the live stream have different noise profiles — the audit
that motivated this work (docs/research/feed-promotion-real-sample-audit.md)
measured BOTH (n=30 seed, n=55 live) — so measure/judge need both signals.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

Follow `gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md` verbatim. `{{TARGET_URL}}`
is expected to be `http://localhost:8095`. Agent pods have no public route to
the viewer; port-forward to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` and authenticate
with a Keycloak `client_credentials` bearer (advice `ka-0000006483`, helper
`gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh`). Also port-forward
`svc/gardenio-beads:8080` and bootstrap the operator row via
`POST /v1/operators/me/aliases` so authenticated pages render real content.

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 > /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
BEADS_PF_PID=$!
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "http://localhost:8095/health" && break; sleep 1; done
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-feed-signal-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases | jq .
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware). With
it, the viewer's `extractToken()` accepts the `Authorization` header directly.


### Steps
1. Re-establish the tunnel + bearer (prereq block above). Export under the names
   the harness reads:
   ```bash
   export BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER=$VIEWER_BEARER
   export SCREENSHOT_FEED=1
   ```
2. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}
   ```
3. Run the harness (captures all canonical pages incl. the two feed pages; keep
   only the feed ones):
   ```bash
   BEADS_VIEWER_URL='{{TARGET_URL}}' make screenshot-beads-viewer
   ```
   Output: `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/{desktop,narrow}/feed{,-lanes}.{png,html}`.
4. Also fetch the rendered HTML for both surfaces (belt-and-suspenders — the
   harness already writes `.html`, but pull again so a harness hiccup doesn't
   leave measure with no DOM) AND a fresh `/feed/events` SSE sample:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/{html,sse}
   for spec in "feed:/feed" "feed-lanes:/feed?view=lanes"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}" \
       -o "docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html"
   done
   # Live SSE sample: ~25s window so a representative burst of live cards lands.
   timeout 25 curl -sN -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" \
     "{{TARGET_URL}}/feed/events" \
     > docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/sse/feed-events.sse || true
   ```
5. Move screenshots into the run dir:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/{desktop,narrow}
   for vp in desktop narrow; do
     for pg in feed feed-lanes; do
       cp gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/$vp/$pg.png \
          docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/$vp/ 2>/dev/null || true
     done
   done
   ```
6. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(feed-quality): capture {{ITERATION}} for /feed + /feed?view=lanes"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch `chore/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}` with `captures/{html,screenshots,sse}/` populated.
- Comment: `du -sh` of captures + commit SHA + confirmation all four desktop+narrow
  PNGs exist AND the SSE sample is non-empty (`wc -l` of feed-events.sse).

If the harness fails, root-cause it (check `/tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log` for a dead
port-forward; re-mint the bearer if it expired) and BLOCK. If the SSE sample is
empty (no live traffic during the window), warn but do NOT block — the seed DOM
alone is enough to measure; note the empty live window in the comment.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): compute signal%, duplicate-run profile, density + correctness
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure (objective; no judgement)

Classify every rendered feed card by family, compute the signal ratio, the
duplicate-run profile, and reuse the density helper for the Legibility vector.
The card taxonomy is defined in `feed.go` (`feedKindForBead` /
`classifyFeedEvent`); each card renders as
`<article class="feed-card feed-card-<name>" data-kind="<name>" ...>` carrying a
`data-bead` / bead id, and consecutive identical cards collapse into one card
with a `feed-card-count` "×N" badge (Phase A3, ka-0000000291).

### Family classification (the heart of the audit)
Parse `data-kind="..."` from `captures/html/feed.html` (seed) and from the
`event: <name>` lines of `captures/sse/feed-events.sse` (live). Bucket each card:

| Bucket | Kinds | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **signal** | `decision`, `mail`, `claimed`, `blocked`, `closed`, `created`, `mr-opened`, `mr-merged`, `pipeline`, `squawk`, `spawned`, `stopped`, `gate` | a genuine workflow transition the operator would want to see |
| **noise** | `updated` (the generic catch-all card) + any card whose bead type is in {account, trigger, event, session, audit, report} | infrastructure heartbeat / bookkeeping churn |

`gate` counts as **signal** only post-A2 (ka-0000007057 gates gate-cards on the
`gate_satisfied_by` *transition*, not field-presence); if you still see a wall of
identical `gate` cards for one agent, that is a regression — count the excess as
noise and flag it.

| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `seed_total` | total feed-card articles in `feed.html` |
| `seed_signal` | seed cards in the signal bucket |
| `seed_signal_pct` | `100 * seed_signal / seed_total` |
| `live_total` | total `event:` card lines in the SSE sample (skip `: comment` keepalives + the `backfill` replay) |
| `live_signal` / `live_signal_pct` | same, over the live stream |
| `combined_signal_pct` | `100 * (seed_signal + live_signal) / (seed_total + live_total)` — **the headline gate number** |
| `family_histogram` | tally of every `data-kind` value seen (seed + live), descending |
| `noise_type_leaks` | count of cards whose underlying bead type is in the A1 noise set {account,trigger,event,session,audit,report} — **should be 0 post-A1** |

### Duplicate-run profile (Rhythm)
The Phase-A3 dedup collapses identical ADJACENT cards into a ×N badge, so a
healthy feed shows few/no badges and no visible repeated lines.

| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `max_dup_run` | the largest N in any `feed-card-count` "×N" badge across both surfaces (1 ⇒ no collapsing needed; the gate wants <= 1) |
| `dup_badge_count` | how many cards carry a ×N badge at all |
| `visible_adjacent_dups` | count of places where two ADJACENT rendered cards share the same kind+bead WITHOUT a ×N badge (a dedup escape — should be 0) |

### Legibility / density (reuse measure-density.py)
Run `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-density.py` over the
captures dir. Per-page (`feed`, `feed-lanes`; desktop + narrow):
`dom_element_count`, `text_byte_count`, `text_byte_per_dom`, `unique_links`,
`data_fields`, and per-screenshot `near_white_ratio`, `mean_luma`, `pixel_count`.

### Correctness signals (both surfaces)
| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `template_leaks` | count of literal `{{` / `}}` / `<no value>` rendered into the body |
| `error_markers` | count of `error`, `failed to`, `nil`, `panic` (case-insensitive), EXCLUDING legitimate `pipeline ... failed` cards |
| `empty_feed` | 1 if either surface rendered zero feed-card articles (blank feed) |

Any `template_leaks > 0`, `error_markers > 0`, `empty_feed == 1`, or
`noise_type_leaks > 0` is an automatic fail flag for the gate.

### Output
Write `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-feed.py` that ingests
the captures dir and emits `docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json`:
```json
{
  "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}", "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "signal": {"seed_total": 0, "seed_signal": 0, "seed_signal_pct": 0.0,
             "live_total": 0, "live_signal": 0, "live_signal_pct": 0.0,
             "combined_signal_pct": 0.0, "family_histogram": {}, "noise_type_leaks": 0},
  "rhythm": {"max_dup_run": 1, "dup_badge_count": 0, "visible_adjacent_dups": 0},
  "legibility": {"feed": {"desktop": {}, "narrow": {}}, "feed-lanes": {"desktop": {}, "narrow": {}}},
  "correctness": {"template_leaks": 0, "error_markers": 0, "empty_feed": 0}
}
```
Commit the helper + metrics.json on the branch.

### Deliverables
- `measure-feed.py` + `metrics.json` committed.
- Comment: the `combined_signal_pct`, `max_dup_run`, the family histogram, and
  the correctness flags in a compact table.
- If a screenshot is unreadable, mark its legibility block `null` and warn — do
  not BLOCK (the judge skips nulls). An empty live SSE window is NOT a block:
  compute the signal gate from the seed alone and note `live_total: 0`.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): score Signal / Legibility / Rhythm + compute the promotion gate
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the S-L-R rubric (Signal / Legibility / Rhythm)

Produce a 0-10 score + verdict for each of the three dimensions, combining the
objective metrics (step 3) with a visual review of the screenshots. **You MUST
visually inspect** the desktop AND narrow PNGs for both `feed` and `feed-lanes`
with the Read tool — the screenshot is the source of truth; metrics only triage.
This page is slated to become the gardenio front page (`/`), so hold the bar
high: "ok" is not good enough; aim recommendations at "tells the story of the
workflow without waste or nonsense" (Matt's exact bar).

### The three dimensions

**S — Signal** (is the feed mostly genuine workflow, not infrastructure churn?)
- Anchor on `combined_signal_pct`: >= 80 ⇒ on-target; 60-80 ⇒ 5-6; < 60 ⇒ <= 4.
  `noise_type_leaks > 0` (an A1 noise type slipped through) ⇒ score <= 4
  regardless of the percentage — the filter regressed.
- The feed must read as a story: claimed → spawned → pipeline → decision →
  closed. Penalize `updated <type>` cards that carry zero workflow meaning and
  any account/trigger heartbeat that survived the filter.
- Visual: scanning the feed top-to-bottom, what fraction of lines would a human
  operator actually care about? Does the eye land on `decision · needs you` and
  `pipeline failed`, or is it lost in grey `updated` noise?
- 10 = nearly every card is a real workflow event; the infra heartbeat is gone.

**L — Legibility** (can a human read the story at a glance? craft of the render)
- Each card's glyph + kind label + bead title + agent + project + "Nm ago" must
  be scannable, aligned, and typographically clear. The color language
  (decision amber, pipeline green/red, gate amber, squawk teal) must guide the
  eye to what matters.
- Anchor partly on density (`near_white_ratio` desktop): a front page should not
  be acres of blank nor a cramped wall — aim for a balanced, designed feel.
- Compare `feed` vs `feed-lanes`: does the lane grouping (now / recently-changed
  / just-done) actually improve legibility, or fragment the story? Call it.
- Visual: narrow viewport must not break the layout; long titles must truncate
  cleanly; the view toggle + scope chips must be discoverable.
- 10 = a newcomer reads the feed and instantly understands what the fleet is doing.

**R — Rhythm** (cadence — no duplicate runs, no flooding, honest bursts)
- Anchor on `max_dup_run` (gate: <= 1) and `visible_adjacent_dups` (must be 0).
  A wall of identical adjacent cards (the old gate-flood failure) is the single
  worst Rhythm smell. A handful of ×N badges is acceptable IF each represents a
  real burst and the badge keeps it to one line.
- The feed should breathe: distinct events in chronological order, bursts
  collapsed honestly with a count, no single agent monopolizing the stream.
- Visual: does the feed feel like a steady heartbeat of distinct work, or a
  stuttering repeat? Are timestamps monotonic and sensible?
- 10 = every line is a distinct beat; bursts are summarized, never spammed.

### Output
`docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json`:
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "scores": {
    "signal":      {"score": 0, "verdict": "broken|weak|ok|good|excellent", "observations": "...", "issues": ["..."], "recommendations": ["..."]},
    "legibility":  {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "rhythm":      {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []}
  },
  "gate": {"combined_signal_pct": 0.0, "max_dup_run": 1,
           "signal_ok": false, "dup_ok": false, "dims_ok": false, "PASS": false},
  "overall": {"score": 0.0, "headline": "one-line state-of-the-feed"}
}
```
Score bands: 0-3 broken, 4-5 weak, 6-7 ok, 8-9 good, 10 excellent.
`overall.score` = mean of the three.

### The promotion gate (compute it explicitly)
Set `gate.PASS = true` IFF ALL of:
- `signal_ok`  : `combined_signal_pct >= 80`
- `dup_ok`     : `max_dup_run <= 1` AND `visible_adjacent_dups == 0`
- `dims_ok`    : all three dimension scores >= 7
- AND every correctness flag is clean (`template_leaks==0`, `error_markers==0`,
  `empty_feed==0`, `noise_type_leaks==0`).

`gate.PASS` is the single fact the Phase-B promotion decision keys off. A formula
pour where PASS=false means the feed is NOT yet promotion-ready this iteration.

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: a 3-row scorecard (dimension | score | verdict | top recommendation)
  + the gate line (`PASS` / `FAIL` with the three sub-conditions) + the headline.
- Full `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for the file-issues step.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads per low-scoring dimension / correctness regression
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every dimension in `verdicts.json` scoring **< 7** (anything short of 'ok+')
file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations, parented to
{{PARENT_EPIC}}. ALSO file a bug for any clean-correctness violation
(`noise_type_leaks`, `template_leaks`, `error_markers`, `empty_feed`) even if the
dimension score is otherwise fine — those are gate-blocking regressions.

### Per-dimension bug bead
```bash
kd create "Feed S-L-R: <Dimension> scored <N>/10 — <one-line>" \
  --type=bug --project=gardenio -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:activity-feed -l kind:feed-quality -l "slr:<dimension>" \
  --description "## Feed signal-quality audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/feed (+ /feed?view=lanes)
Dimension: <Signal|Legibility|Rhythm>
Score: <N>/10  (verdict: <verdict>)
Gate this iteration: <PASS|FAIL>  (combined_signal_pct=<x>, max_dup_run=<y>)

## Observations
<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Issues
- <bullet>

## Recommended fixes
- <bullet>

## Evidence
- Feed desktop:       docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/feed.png
- Feed-lanes desktop: docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/feed-lanes.png
- Narrow:             docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/narrow/
- Metrics:            docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json
- SSE sample:         docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/captures/sse/feed-events.sse

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Deduplication (per dimension)
Before filing, search for an open bead with the same dimension scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:feed-quality -l "slr:<dimension>" 2>&1
```
If one exists, comment the new iteration's score + evidence on it (reference both
iterations) instead of filing a duplicate. If the dimension has recovered to 7+
this iteration, comment that on the open bead and propose closing it.

### Deliverables
- Comment listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID + its dimension + score.
- If `gate.PASS == true` this iteration, comment 'GATE PASSED: combined signal
  >= 80%, max-dup <= 1, all S-L-R dims >= 7 — /feed is promotion-ready 🎉' so the
  report + promotion-decision step can key off it.
- Do NOT close {{PARENT_EPIC}} — the report step rolls up first.

steps.title: Feed S-L-R ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report, land the MR, refresh the promotion gate
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR (+ refresh the promotion gate)

Produce a single rolled-up report on the parent epic and land the
captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR (so future iterations diff). Then —
because this formula IS the promotion gate — surface the PASS/FAIL state for the
Phase-B decision.

### Steps
1. Build `docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`:
   - Header: iteration, target URL, date, the promotion gate verdict (PASS/FAIL).
   - S-L-R scorecard: 3-row table — dimension | score | verdict | filed bug bead.
   - Gate line: `combined_signal_pct`, `max_dup_run`, `visible_adjacent_dups`,
     correctness flags, and the boolean PASS.
   - Headline (one-line state of the feed) + overall mean.
   - Inline embed: desktop screenshots of `feed` and `feed-lanes`.
   - Family histogram (what the feed is actually made of this iteration).
   - Trends: if a previous iteration exists at `docs/feed-quality/<previous>/`,
     diff `combined_signal_pct` + `max_dup_run` + each dimension score; flag
     regressions explicitly.
   - Index of bug beads filed/updated.

2. Commit + push + open MR:
   ```bash
   git add docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
   git commit -m "chore(feed-quality): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report"
   git push -u origin chore/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}
   glab mr create \
     --title "chore(feed-quality): {{ITERATION}} S-L-R audit" \
     --description "Automated feed signal-quality (S-L-R) audit for {{TARGET_URL}}/feed.

Report: docs/feed-quality/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
Parent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}
Promotion gate this iteration: <PASS|FAIL>
Operator: Matt Baker" \
     --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge
   ```

3. Wait for CI green; on a transient flake, retrigger the pipeline (NEVER
   close/reopen — global advice on pipeline retriggers).

4. Self-merge once green (operator pre-authorized via global advice ka-0000002230
   for gardenio repos).

5. Comment on parent epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}:
   ```
   Iteration {{ITERATION}} complete.
   Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/feed
   ```
